**FINDING (C4 review MAJOR-1, needs ruling): records-only pull re-stamps created_at — engram save has no timestamp flag, local recency ordering skewed after every pull**

What: Fresh-review MAJOR-1 on C4 (#229). The records-only pull (D2) writes each observation via `engram save`, which accepts --type/--project/--scope/--topic but has NO timestamp flag. So `importRecord()` computes `created_at: toEngramNaive(record.ts)` but the save primitive DISCARDS it — every hydrated observation is re-stamped with engram's wall-clock insert time. The OLD `engram sync --import` (chunk transport) preserved original timestamps; the records-only path does not.

Impact: recency-ordered LOCAL engram search/mem_context is skewed after every pull (all hydrated obs get ~now). NOT data loss: the committed `.memory/records/` keeps the correct `ts` (source of truth); engram is a rebuildable cache. Does NOT affect idempotency (topic_key upsert keys on project+scope+topic, all stable).

Status: DISCLOSED in code (comment at _defaultEngramSave, engram.mjs ~985) + MINOR-1 fixed in same pass (now passes --scope so importRecord's declared scope is honored). NEEDS HUMAN RULING at CP-C4: (a) ACCEPT as documented + file follow-up to add engram-side timestamp-preserving ingestion (a --created-at flag or a bulk records-import verb) — recommended, since records/ is source of truth and the fix is engram-side (out of C4 scope); or (b) block C4 until timestamps can be preserved.

Where: brain/scripts/memory/backends/engram.mjs (_defaultEngramSave + importMemory call site), importRecord (engram-import.mjs:71 computes created_at). Related: [[sdd/issue-229-c4/kickoff]]. Also fixed this pass: MINOR-2 (D1 empty-store test used early `return` = false-green in node:test → now t.skip).
